text: I think you'll really enjoy this Tibetan Greens With Tofu recipe, which fits perfectly with your vegan dietary preferences and high protein requirements. The dish is packed with protein-rich tofu, which should help you meet your health goal, and is also a great source of fiber from the swiss chard and green peas. The recipe is quick to prepare, taking only about 20 minutes, and can be ready in under 45 minutes, which fits within your time budget. Overall, it's a nutritious and satisfying option that should appeal to your taste buds.
